diff --git a/lib/http.h b/lib/http.h
index 6232bbc3a5f1..5bacb1754542 100644
--- a/lib/http.h
+++ b/lib/http.h
@@ -176,7 +176,6 @@ struct HTTP {
   int status_code; /* HTTP status code */
   const uint8_t *pausedata; /* pointer to data received in on_data_chunk */
   size_t pauselen; /* the number of bytes left in data */
-  bool closed; /* TRUE on HTTP2 stream close */
   bool close_handled; /* TRUE if stream closure is handled by libcurl */
 
   char **push_headers;       /* allocated array */
@@ -184,6 +183,7 @@ struct HTTP {
   size_t push_headers_alloc; /* number of entries allocated */
 #endif
 #if defined(USE_NGHTTP2) || defined(USE_NGHTTP3)
+  bool closed; /* TRUE on HTTP2 stream close */
   char *mem;     /* points to a buffer in memory to store received data */
   size_t len;    /* size of the buffer 'mem' points to */
   size_t memlen; /* size of data copied to mem */
diff --git a/lib/vquic/ngtcp2.c b/lib/vquic/ngtcp2.c
index 008a75cfdc46..1cdbb7d39df4 100644
--- a/lib/vquic/ngtcp2.c
+++ b/lib/vquic/ngtcp2.c
@@ -1784,12 +1784,6 @@ static CURLcode http_request(struct connectdata *conn, const void *mem,
     }
   }
 
-  stream->header_recvbuf = Curl_add_buffer_init();
-  if(!stream->header_recvbuf) {
-    result = CURLE_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
-    goto fail;
-  }
-
   switch(data->set.httpreq) {
   case HTTPREQ_POST:
   case HTTPREQ_POST_FORM:
